summary: Compassionate appointment voided over criminal charges; antecedent verification pre-appointment; discharge upheld under RPF Rules 52.2, 67.2; acquittal not mandatory for reinstatement; delay in challenge; moral turpitude in charges; Pawan Kumar distinguished; Methu Meda cited; HC interference improper; discharge order valid.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; writ petition treated as dismissed.
